Basic ATC

خطوة جانبية

A maneuver to change from one parallel runway to another during approach.

What is خطوة جانبية?

In this glossary, خطوة جانبية refers to: A maneuver to change from one parallel runway to another during approach.

How is خطوة جانبية used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ATC يوجه: 'خطوة جانبية إلى المدرج 28L، مسموح بالهبوط.'"
